messages:
sam: noticed a small but consistent uptick in funcall JSON parse failures on the int4 canary this morning. errors frequently show an odd escape sequence in the args string (\\u0000-like).

nina: is this during streaming chunk assembly or after we stitch the final tokens? any pattern w/ prompt types?

sam: all from streaming responses. happens on nested tool args where users include code blocks. example tokenized output fragment we captured: 
```
... \"args\": {\"snippet\": \"print(\\u0000)\"}, 
```
(weird null-like escape injected mid-string).

lee: int4 kernel currently uses a slimmed streamer that does a different UTF-8 validation pass. could be a decoder edge-case when a token boundary splits a 2-byte control sequence.

qa: crash rate: 0.3% total invocations but 1.9% for calls containing backticks or triple-quoted blocks. skewed to batch-size 8 on dedicated canary 12.

ops-bot: deployed int4-canary -> node-pool-12 at 2024-07-02T09:10Z :white_check_mark:

nina: proposed experiment: run mirrored-synchronous for 5k streaming invokes, mirror to fp16, and do token-align diffs +/- 64 tokens around any controlchar. log the raw byte stream to S3 for forensic. also disable streaming-chunk-collation optimization for int4 in the canary to see if stitch logic is culprit.

sam: i'll schedule the mirrored run and add a focused eval set with lots of code/markdown snippets: /evals/escape-seq-int4-regen. will also tag the sample ids in the canary issue.

lee: additionally, add a check in the runtime: if token bytes contain isolated continuation bytes at chunk boundaries, force re-decode with fallback decoder and emit a diagnostic metric. that should help prove whether it's a decoder bug vs model emitting control tokens.

qa: let's also add a harness assertion: any funcall payload that fails JSON schema should trigger a retry with jitter up to 2 attempts and if still failing, mirror the request to fp16 and mark as degraded. record full generator logits + topk for the failure window.

sam: short-term mitigation accepted: disable the streaming-collation microopt for int4 canary and flip on the fallback decoder metric. long-term: patch streamer kernel and add rollout gate that prevents canary promotion if structured-acceptance regressions >0.2% over 2h.

ops-bot: created issue INT4-ESCAPESEQ-23 and attached sample artifacts.

nina: thanks — ping when the mirrored run completes. we'll assemble a token-aligned diff report and decide kernel vs model rollback. :mag:
